item.title: Restless Ghosts: One Case, A Century of Doubt | Case by Case | "48 Hours" Podcast
item.description: Nearly 100 years ago, two young socialites were found dead in a New Jersey mansion. Ruled a murder-suicide, the case sparked rumors of a cover-up, a controversial investigation, and questions that still linger today. CBS News correspondent Jim Axelrod talks with journalist and author Annie McCormick about the mystery that wouldn't stay buried.
